content: fig:rcv1arch, shows the architecture for the end-to-end text categorization task. On the bottom of the architecture $S_e$ receives word embeddings and outputs a sentence vector $S$ . The $S$ vector pass through a fully connected (FC) layer with sigmoid activation function that outputs a vector $\hat{y} \in \mathbb {R}^{55}$ with each element $\hat{y}_j \in [0,1]$ .
